label_convention: DT4N-L1 | intervention y[t]=1 iff inject_tick < t <= revert_tick; collector monotonic event/snapshot anchors; actuation may cross measurement boundaries. Primary: strict point-wise after warmup only. Sensitivity: exclude onset=2, recovery=2 ticks; grace never changes y. No point-adjust for primary evaluation.
